overview: The Patrol Muster Grounds is where Vah Shir hunters, guards, and scouts assemble for patrols and expeditions.
history: The grounds were established to coordinate early patrols beyond Shar Vahl.
Map tables and signal braziers were added to support long-range operations.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the grounds were expanded with new platforms.
Royal Guard and Hunter’s Quarter began joint patrol briefings here.
Shadow-Threat Watch uses the grounds for perimeter scan coordination.
hooks: A patrol returns with news of a new threat in Shadeweaver’s Thicket.
Signal braziers flare unexpectedly, hinting at perimeter breaches.
A joint patrol briefing reveals conflicting reports from scouts.
Supply mishaps delay a critical patrol departure.
